blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Jordon Varnado made crucial offensive plays down the stretch as Meralco survived Blackwater’s comeback to take a 120-115 win in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup on Tuesday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Varnado scored or assisted in the Bolts’ last nine points to beat the Bossing despite squandering a 20-point lead and move up to solo fourth in a tight Group B with a 4-5 win-loss record. READ: PBA: Meralco banking on Jordon Varnado’s versatility The Meralco import finished with 31 points, seven rebounds, seven assists, two steals and two blocks.
